dct_description_sm: Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
List of administrative subdivisions of each province on verso.

Not drawn to scale. Shows 23 provinces of China, including Taiwan. Also shows Korea, and Japan. Pictorial map. Wood block print. Relief shown pictorially. Oriented with north toward the upper right.
